os-11-2.alt: Two drawings of a bent arm holding a glass. In the first, the long muscle on the front of the upper arm runs from the shoulder to the forearm, with arrows showing it pulling upward, and a second muscle runs along the thumb side of the forearm. In the second, the front muscle is cut away to show a deeper muscle beneath it that crosses the elbow.

os-11-3.alt: A front view of the whole muscular system with boxes drawn around seven muscles, each enlarged around the edge: a ring of muscle around the mouth, a fan-shaped chest muscle, a thick feathered muscle capping the shoulder, a spindle-shaped arm muscle with its belly and tendons marked, a forearm muscle with fibers slanting into one side of a tendon, a front-of-thigh muscle with fibers slanting into both sides of a central tendon, and a long strap-like muscle crossing the thigh.
